name: @pipeworx/mcp-ia-dmv

tools.name: ia_dmv_driver_license_stations
tools.description: Find Iowa DOT driver license stations with street address, per-day opening hours, phone, coordinates, whether the station does commercial driver license (CDL) testing, and the live queue-camera image URLs Iowa points at its own waiting rooms so a caller can see how long the line is right now. Covers all 18 Motor Vehicle Division stations statewide, so it answers "Iowa driver license station in Des Moines", "where can I take the CDL test in Iowa", "what time does the Mason City DL station open on Saturday", or "show me the wait at an Iowa DMV". Filter by city, station name or CDL testing; call with no arguments for all 18.

city.description: City name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Des Moines", "Mason City", "Cedar Rapids".

cdl_only.description: Set true to keep only stations that perform commercial driver license (CDL) testing.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ia-dmv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ia-dmv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
